question: After the complete terminal-hit class and exact cross-turn representation are validly closed, can the owner-ordered intent-history class support exactly one finite, source-compatible twelve-field Dusk-only fight-local contract before any support or simulator row is read?
hypothesis: The shortest directly attributable intent-history primitive is an exact consecutive authored-intent repeat on one enemy, followed during that telegraph window by a normal exact-target Attack and one deferred Ember.
claimBoundary: Exact-source, immutable-closure, finite-grammar legality and lexicographic representation selection only. No natural support, causal endpoint, policy control, complementarity, package, detector, product, protected-seed, #421 acceptance or P9 claim.

scientificBasis.serialEntry: The exact cross-turn hold representation is closed by the immutable post-result coverage audit before capacity. Owner comment 5460811702 orders intent-history next.

scientificBasis.naturalCost: The player must spend and legally play an authored Attack against the exact enemy during its one telegraph window before that enemy acts.
scientificBasis.noGuessing: Candidate construction and ordering use exact current-main source, immutable closed-family dispositions and the owner lexicographic objective only. No support row, frequency, outcome, enemy subset, card subset or optimiser is read.
